papers.authors: Sergei Kholkin, Evgeny Burnaev, Alexander Korotin
papers.evidence: 对源与目标分布间已学薛定谔桥进行后训练微调的方法
papers.tldr: Schrödinger bridge 为无配对域翻译提供熵正则框架，但预训练桥难按奖励适配到人类偏好或物理约束。本文提出 Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching（TSBM），将微调目标设为奖励倾斜分布 p1^r∝p1e^r，并保持源分布 p0。方法从预训练桥 P 出发，用交替优化与基于 Adjoint Matching 的实用算法实现后训练。在 MNIST 数字属性和 CelebA 人脸属性的无配对图像翻译任务上验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridges provide an entropy-regularized framework and a principled solution for unpaired domain translation. In practice, a pretrained bridge may need to be adapted to human preferences or physical constraints through a reward a problem closely related to reward tilting in diffusion models but underexplored for Schrödinger bridges. We introduce Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM), a post-training method for fine-tuning a learned bridge $P$ between source $p_0$ and target $p_1$ toward a reward-tilted target $p_1^r\propto p_1e^r$, while preserving source $p_0$. We formulate this adaptation as alternating optimization initialized from $P$, provide theoretical justification, and derive a practical algorithm based on Adjoint Matching. We evaluate TSBM on unpaired image-to-image translation targeting digit properties in MNIST and facial attributes in CelebA.

papers.title_en: Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View
papers.authors: Boyang Li, Matthew Kim, Sylvia Herbert
papers.evidence: 流策略更新的广义薛定谔桥视角
papers.tldr: 在线安全强化学习需在奖励与安全约束间权衡，但奖励与安全可导致多模态动作分布，高斯策略易坍缩、原始-对偶优化不稳定。本文直接沿流策略生成路径微分增广目标，无需估计score，并提出无密度动能正则的安全RL方法RAFALE。作者将其更新建模为约束单端广义薛定谔桥，证明正噪声下仅对估计成本超阈值区域重加权。在七个Safety-Gymnasium任务上，RAFALE取得有竞争力奖励且各任务最终成本均在预算内，优于需权衡的基线。
papers.abstract_en: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. Reward and safety can induce multimodal action distributions, challenging the prevailing primal-dual methods: Gaussian actors may collapse onto a single suboptimal mode, and optimization over the nonconvex Lagrangian landscape can be unstable. Diffusion and flow policies can represent such distributions, but recent work with a diffusion actor relies on estimating and matching the score of an augmented-Lagrangian target policy. Instead, we differentiate the augmented objective directly through the generation path of a flow policy, so no score needs to be estimated. Because a flow policy lacks a readily available action log-density for entropy regularization, we build on the density-free kinetic-energy regularizer of FLAC, a recent reward-only method, and propose Reparameterized Augmented-Lagrangian Flow Actor with Least Energy (RAFALE), an off-policy actor-critic method for safe RL. We formulate its update as a constrained one-ended generalized Schrödinger bridge and show that, for each source draw, this path-space problem is exactly an entropy-regularized problem in action space. At positive noise, its solution reweights the reward-only action distribution only where the estimated cost exceeds a threshold set by the Lagrange multiplier. As the noise vanishes, the optimal value converges to that of a least-energy map objective that the flow policy optimizes directly. Across seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks, RAFALE achieves competitive reward with mean final cost within budget on every task, whereas strong baselines trade one for the other; ablations support the necessity of both its augmented objective and its flow actor.

papers.title_en: DOHF: Online Diffusion Fine-tuning with Doob's $h$-transform Guidance
papers.authors: Zhengyi Guo, Jiayuan Sheng, Wenpin Tang
papers.evidence: Doob h变换引导，与桥及薛定谔桥条件化核心相关
papers.tldr: 奖励型扩散微调在目标结果稀少或条件修正估计昂贵时难以实用。DOHF 将 Doob h-变换转化为在线训练算法，为生成样本分配最优性权重，并估计当前 rollout 策略下的归一化局部修正 ∇log h，再蒸馏进生成模型。理论上统一刻画了 DiffusionNFT 与无分类器引导，方法上支持黑盒、不可微奖励且无需额外网络评估。三类实验中取得更好对齐，展示低成本估计与迭代蒸馏可改进统计采样与视觉生成。
papers.abstract_en: Reward-based diffusion fine-tuning faces practical challenges when desirable outcomes are rare or conditioning corrections are costly to estimate. In this work, we propose Diffusion Online $h$-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF), which turns Doob's $h$-transform into a practical online training algorithm. DOHF assigns optimality weights to generated samples, estimates the normalized local correction $\nabla\log h$ under the current rollout policy, and distills it directly into the generative model. Theoretically, we characterize the population-optimal DiffusionNFT update as well as the various classfier free guidance methods through a unified $h$-transform perspective. Methodologically, our framework accommodates black-box and non-differentiable rewards without additional network evaluations. We further show improved alignments under three empirical scenarios. Our work demonstrates how adapting probabilistic conditioning through inexpensive estimation and iterative distillation can improve generative learning across statistical sampling and visual generation.

papers.authors: João Guerreiro, Pedro Tomás, Helena Aidos, Jacinto C. Nascimento
papers.evidence: 受扩散桥端点约束启发、用于逆问题的残差扩散隐式模型
papers.tldr: 扩散模型在逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化不匹配；扩散桥约束严格且长反演易生幻觉，一致性模型则缺乏方差建模。为此提出残差扩散隐式模型RDIM，显式建模高低质量图像残差，并推导可跳步的非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，支持少步甚至单步重建，同时以可控方差机制平衡保真与多样性。在去噪与超分基准上，其PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS均优于扩散桥和一致性模型，减少幻觉且常仅需一步。该工作为图像复原提供了高效通用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.
